page.layout: Single printed page, right of the binding. Full-width running head at top with page number 39 at upper right. Below: a centred title block (TABVLA QUARTA and a two-to-three line title), then a large table of nine columns with a left-hand cycle column. Below the table: three paragraphs of running text and a signature line at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: TABVLA QUARTA.
main_text.p: Termini neomeniarum Thisri, quos proximè antecedit vel sequitur Rosch Haschana, docente feria politica.

main_text.p: Trecentis quibusq; annis termini minuuntur die uno. Quare quæ libet columna usui esse potest ad annos fere sexcentos.
Columna nostri seculi præcesserat pag. 22. sed hoc loco repetenda fuit.
Termini Paschales hos præcedunt diebus 163, in eodem anno Romano.

page.notes: The table rows are set in a ruled grid; the cycle column carries "b" marks for embolismic years. Cells are separated by " | " as the table has no printed header row beyond the column titles. The header text of the Cyclus column is printed rotated and is read here as "Cyclus Lu. nae Judaic.". The running head is read as IVDAICO from the printed "I VDAICO" with a split letter. The word "Tabularum" at the foot is a catchword-like signature at the right and is given as a foot line. Some digits in the table are faint and may be misread.
